source_text: A retrospective analysis of 80 cases of vesicovaginal fistula (VVF) in children under 13 years old in northern Nigeria identified 12 instances (15%) directly resulting from gishiri cutting, where incisions into the anterior vaginal wall inadvertently damaged the bladder or urethra.
